## - Staff Allocation %

- Figures: `figs/[TYPE]/m-staff_allocation_only-[1:4].png`

```{r m-staff_allocation_only}
#| fig-show: "hold"
#| out-width: "50%"
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-cap: "Per Year"
#| fig-subcap: 
#|   - "Model 1: Cross Sectional"
#|   - "Model 2: Diff in Diff"

# cross-sectional 
m_staff_allocation_only_cross <- fenegbin (
  perYear ~ 
    pct_legis_staff + 
    #pct_pol_staff + 
    pct_comm_staff + 
    #pct_off_staff + 
    pct_constit_staff + pct_policy_staff +
    # chair + 
    # subchr + state_leg +  
    # ranking_minority + 
    # oversight +
    # experience + 
    # majority + 
    presidents_party | Year_x_Agency,
  cluster = "Legislator", 
  data = data_member)

if(testing){modelsummary::modelsummary(m_staff_allocation_only_cross, gof_omit = "R.*", coef_omit = coef_omit)}

coefplot(m_staff_allocation_only_cross, horiz = T, drop = "(Intercept)") 



# 2
m_staff_allocation_only_did <-fenegbin (
  perYear ~ 
    pct_legis_staff + 
    #pct_pol_staff + 
    pct_comm_staff + 
    #pct_off_staff + 
    pct_constit_staff + pct_policy_staff +
    # chair + 
    #subchr + state_leg +  
    # ranking_minority + 
    # oversight +
    # experience + 
    #majority + 
    presidents_party  | Year_x_Agency + Legislator_x_Agency, 
                    cluster = "Legislator",
                    # ALT vcov = hetero ~ ssc(cluster.adj = TRUE),
           data = data_member)

if(testing){modelsummary::modelsummary(m_staff_allocation_only_did, gof_omit = "R.*", coef_omit = coef_omit)}

coefplot(m_staff_allocation_only_did, horiz = T, drop = ".theta") 


```

### Table - Staff %

```{r m-staff_allocation_only-models}
models_staff_allocation_only <- list(
      "(1)" =  m_staff_allocation_only_cross,
  "(2)" = m_staff_allocation_only_did,
    "(3)" =  m_house_staff_allocation_only_cross,
  "(4)" = m_house_staff_allocation_only_did,
  "(5)" =  m_senate_staff_allocation_only_cross,
  "(6)" = m_senate_staff_allocation_only_did
)
rows <- tibble(
  term = c("Dependent variable",
           "All legislators",
           "Only House",
           "Only Senate"),
 `(1)` = c("Count", "X", "", ""),
  `(2)` = c("Count", "X", "", ""),
    `(3)` = c("Count", "", "X", ""),
  `(4)` = c("Count", "", "X", ""),
  `(5)` = c("Count", "", "", "X"),
  `(6)` = c("Count", "", "", "X"),
  )
attr(rows, 'position') <- c(0)

# HTML
modelsummary(models_staff_allocation_only, 
             title = "The Effect of Staff Allocation on Legislator Contacts", 
             notes = list("Robust standard errors in parentheses, clustered by legislator."))

beta_cross <- betas(m_staff_allocation_only_cross)
se_cross <- standard_errors(m_staff_allocation_only_cross)
beta_did <- betas(m_staff_allocation_only_did)
se_did <- standard_errors(m_staff_allocation_only_did)

save(models_staff_allocation_only, rows, cm, gm,   beta_cross, beta_did, se_cross, se_did,
     file = here::here("models", type, "models_staff_allocation_only.Rdata"))
```

### Modeled Effects - Staff % - cross sectional 

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#| label: "m-staff_allocation_only-effect"
#| fig-cap: "figs/[TYPE]/m-staff_allocation_only-effect"
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| fig-width: 3.5
#| fig-subcap: 
#|   - "1"
#|   - "2"
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-show: "hold"

model <- m_staff_allocation_only_cross
data = data_member |> filter(year > 2007,  year < 2019)

plot_effect( 
  newdata = mutate(data, pct_constit_staff = 0),
  effect = "%Constit. Serv. Staff"
  )

plot_effect( 
  newdata = mutate(data, pct_comm_staff = 0),
  effect = "%Comms Staff"
  )
```
